# Branches that deploy the BrainTF infrastructure (terraform/main_module) to the
# DEV environment on push. One branch name per line (exact match of the ref name,
# e.g. feature/EPMCACMAWS-504-automated-deployment). Blank lines and lines starting
# with "#" are ignored.
#
# This file is the single source of truth for BOTH:
#   - the deploy-braintf.yml workflow gate (which branches trigger a dev deploy), and
#   - the OIDC role trust policy (terraform/main_module/main.tf local.sub_values),
#     so a branch listed here is also allowed to assume the AWS role.
#
# NOTE: main is implicit and always deploys to PROD - do not list it here.
# After adding/removing a branch, re-apply the PROD state so the shared OIDC
# role's trust picks up the change.
feature/EPMCACMAWS-504-automated-deployment
